title: EHR-RobustGym: Benchmarking and Training Agents for Robust Clinical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.39371v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In hospital workflows, electronic health records (EHRs) are often noisy, and may not contain the evidence needed to confirm events or measurements referenced in a clinical query. Even when database retrieval succeeds, clinical agents can overlook such discrepancies and return plausible but unsupported answers. We introduce EHR-RobustGym, a scalable and interactive environment for evaluating and training robust clinical agents grounded in noisy EHRs. Built on MIMIC-IV hospital records (365K patients, 31 tables, and over 500M records), EHR-RobustGym comprises 5,486 Clean-Noise pairs spanning six clinical intents and both patient-level and population-level queries. The pairs test robustness to Record-level, Value-level, and Query-level noise, while interactive SQL/Python execution and outcome verification support trajectory collection and training. translated_title: EHR-RobustGym：面向鲁棒临床推理的智能体基准测试与训练环境
translated_abstract: 在医院工作流程中，电子健康记录（EHR）通常充满噪声，且可能不包含确认临床查询中所引用事件或测量值所需的证据。即使数据库检索成功，临床智能体也可能忽视这些差异，返回看似合理但缺乏依据支持的答案。我们提出了EHR-RobustGym，这是一个可扩展的交互式环境，用于评估和训练基于噪声EHR的鲁棒临床智能体。EHR-RobustGym建立在MIMIC-IV医院记录之上（涵盖365,000名患者、31张数据表、超过5亿条记录），包含5,486对“干净-噪声”数据对，涵盖六种临床意图以及患者层面和人群层面的查询。这些数据对用于测试智能体对记录级、值级和查询级噪声的鲁棒性，同时交互式SQL/Python执行与结果验证机制支持轨迹数据的收集和训练。对多个大语言模型的评估揭示了显著的鲁棒性差距：智能体的平均任务成功率在……
tldr: 提出了EHR-RobustGym——一个基于MIMIC-IV构建、包含5,486对干净-噪声数据对的可扩展交互式环境，用于评估并训练能在噪声电子健康记录下保持鲁棒临床推理的智能体。
en_tdlr: We introduce EHR-RobustGym, a scalable interactive environment built on MIMIC-IV with 5,486 clean-noise pairs, designed to benchmark and train clinical agents for robust reasoning over noisy electronic health records.
